# MGA Tech Consulting

> AI, Automation & BI Consulting for SMBs | Buenos Aires, Argentina

## About

MGA Tech Consulting is a technology consultancy specialized in process automation, applied AI and Business Intelligence for small and medium businesses (SMBs/PyMEs) in Argentina. The firm is led by its founder, Mariano Gobea Alcoba, a Data & Analytics Technical Leader (profile: https://www.mgatc.com/portfolio/). Its expertise covers Data Engineering, Business Intelligence, Machine Learning and applied AI to solve real-world business challenges, helping companies automate processes and leverage data to grow.

## Expertise

- Data Engineering: BigQuery, Apache Airflow, Apache Kafka, dbt, Python (pandas, polars, asyncio)
- Machine Learning & AI: GenAI, LLMs, LangChain, LlamaIndex, vector databases, embeddings, prompt engineering
- Business Intelligence: Looker Studio, real-time dashboards, automated reports
- Process Automation: n8n, RPA, Python scripts, AI chatbots
- Cloud: Google Cloud Platform (GCP), GitHub Actions CI/CD

## Services (Consulting)

- [Services overview](https://www.mgatc.com/servicios/) ([English](https://www.mgatc.com/en/servicios/)): fixed-scope offers with public pricing, plus custom projects quoted to scope.
  - [Automation Diagnostic](https://www.mgatc.com/en/servicios/diagnostico-automatizacion/): USD 99, 75-minute session, written report in 48 h with prioritized automation opportunities.
  - [1:1 Tech Mentoring](https://www.mgatc.com/en/servicios/mentoria-uno-a-uno/): USD 80, 60-minute session, immediate action plan.
  - [Data & AI Audit](https://www.mgatc.com/en/servicios/auditoria-data-ia/): USD 249, 90-minute session, report in 5 days.
  - [Repository & App Agentification](https://www.mgatc.com/en/servicios/agentificacion/): custom quote, applied kit and runbook so AI agents can work safely on your codebase or app.
  - [Custom AI Agents](https://www.mgatc.com/en/servicios/agentes-a-medida/): custom quote, agent in production plus runbook.
- [Tech Consulting landing](https://www.mgatc.com/consulting/): process automation (n8n, Python, AI), applied AI, BI dashboards and data pipelines for SMBs.
- [How we work](https://www.mgatc.com/como-trabajamos/): the 4-step process (free diagnosis, custom proposal, agile implementation, continuous support).

## Open Source Tools

- [PyPI packages in numbers](https://www.mgatc.com/en/recursos/pypi-stats/) ([Spanish](https://www.mgatc.com/recursos/pypi-stats/)): daily downloads, version and GitHub activity of the Python packages published on PyPI (ia-router, n8n-flow-manager, kaggle-downloader-package, argendolar, missing-mga). Open data from pypistats.org, refreshed daily.
- [ia-router](https://www.mgatc.com/en/recursos/ia-router/) ([Spanish](https://www.mgatc.com/recursos/ia-router/)): free, Apache-2.0 command-line router that splits tasks across the official AI CLIs (claude, codex, agy) using objective metrics from Arena and Artificial Analysis. Python 3.9+, no dependencies; available for macOS, Linux and Windows (with WSL 2).
  - Install with Homebrew: `brew install Mgobeaalcoba/tap/ia-router` ([tap](https://github.com/Mgobeaalcoba/homebrew-tap))
  - Install with pip/pipx: `pipx install ia-router` ([PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/ia-router/))
  - Browser UI: `ia-router ui` opens a local tab (127.0.0.1 only) with the same identity as the CLI and everything the CLI does: chat with streaming, attachments, compare, routing preview, scores, priorities, metrics, usage, logins, a connector manager (templates, free commands with confirmation, URLs) and saved conversations
  - v0.6: piped input and `--json` for scripts, `ask --compare`, `ia-router usage` (quota meter), saved sessions (`--continue`), streaming answers, connectors attached per task, connector templates
  - First-run onboarding (v0.5): the chat checks which official CLIs are installed and logged in and gives the exact step for each missing one; repeat with `/setup` or `ia-router setup`
  - Connectors (v0.4): register MCP servers (Gmail, Calendar, Slack, GitHub…) once and any model uses them through one proxy; `ia-router connectors add NAME -- COMMAND`
  - Source code and docs (English): https://github.com/Mgobeaalcoba/ia-suscription-router
  - The program's interface and documentation are in English; it classifies tasks written in English or Spanish.
